<!-- pr-reviewer: 6780996f8606b5546f5422ac510dea29d237b106 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test-only change plus a decision file; no product code, no dependency, build.rs, scripts or process-file changes.
- The test now pins the behaviour it names (`stepped_stock_rapid.rs` ~L263-300): for both Part and Stock sources, the coarse deleted casting is blocked by name (`post blocked`, `model 'casting'`, `model_fidelity::TOO_COARSE`); the rapid law still convicts the dive (`Warning::RapidInStock`, so the stock-top acquittal is still refused on an unknown chord); and the exact-and-deleted twin is blocked by the rapid law by name (`rapid move <at> `). It no longer passes on "any refusal", and the `Ok(())` arms panic, so a posted dive fails the test.
- The gate order is unchanged; the fidelity-first reading matches the decision file (#864, #1056 point 3, #1127). Prime Directive holds: nothing posts.
- Placement: the file stays in `crates/app/tests/`, and it uses app-defined fixtures and `camcraft_app::model_fidelity`. Runtime 0.66 s in debug.

**Local results (merged with current main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stepped_stock_rapid` | 8 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test stepped_stock_rapid -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | maps to motion and app suites; only the touched suite was run, since no product code changed |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Process: body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #1336`; the decision file is in `docs/decisions/` as the law asks.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

|---|---|---|---|
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 76k | ~$0.21 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.
Effort: effort:high
